 CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMIT SHARMA  ORDER % 21.03.2023 1.

The present applications under Section 438 of the Cr.P.C. seeks anticipatory bail in FIR No.
0476/2021 under Sections 420/468/471/34 of the IPC, registered at P.S. Tigri.

2. The case of the prosecution as recorded in the status report authored by Inspector Rajneesh Kumar, SHO/Tigri, New Dehi is as under:
"1. That a complaint was filed by Mr. Deepak Kumar s/o Late Sh.
Vedpal r/o H-16/550, Sangam Vihar, New Delhi against the present petitioners.
In his complaint, the complainant alleged that present petitioners are original residents of Village Kishanpur, Distt Baghpat, Uttar Pradesh and presently reside in Sangam Vihar.

He further alleged that present petitioners belong to Cast Dheevar which falls in OBC list of Uttar Pradesh and they have fradulently obtained cast certificate in the name of Mallah Cast which comes in SC list of Delhi.
2. In this regard, on 16.12.2021 in pursuance to the directions of Hon'ble Court of LD MM, Saket Courts, New Delhi, the present case was registered and the investigation was taken up.
During investigation, the original cast certificates of the alleged persons were procured and notices were sent to concerned agencies for their verification.
3. The cast certificate of petitioner Baburam has apparently issued by Deputy Commissioner Delhi on 04.05.1983 vides Serial Number 1612/83 and the cast has been mentioned as Mallah.

However, said document could not be verified by the concerned authorities and the record of the same is not available with the concerned Rashmi vs State (Nct Of Delhi) And Anr on 21 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/133585712/
2 authorities.

sentences.text:
On basis of the said Cast Certificate, the children of petitioner Baburam,
i.e. petitioner Rashmi, petitioner Rahul and petitioner Rohit also got cast certificates issued in their favor by the concerned authorities on 06.02.2003, 13.06.2009 and 06.07.2005 respectively. All the petitioners have cast certificates belonging to Mallah Cast which is recognized as Scheduled Cast in Delhi.
4. During further investigation, the enquiries were made at native village of petitioner Baburam in Village Kishanpura, Baghpat Distt, UP.
The Sarpanch of village certified that the petitioner Baburam is well known to her and he belongs to Dheevar (Kashyap) Cast and comes in OBC list in UP.
Sarpanch also certified that there are no people belonging to Mallah cast in their village.
Further the enquiry was also made at Village Daha Chittamkhedi, Distt Baghpat, U P where the petitioner Baburam has married.
There, the Sarpanch of the village certified that brothers in law of petitioner Baburam are well known to her and they belong to Dheevar (Kashyap) Cast and comes in OBC list in UP.
5. Further a notice was also issued to Tehsildar Baraut, Distt. Baghpat, U.P. to verify the east of the petitioner Babu Ram.
In reply, Tehsildar Baraut has verified the cast of the petitioner Baburam s/o Hardwari Lal r/o Village- Kishanpur, tehsil Baraut, as Dheewar and the same comes in list of OBC.
6. The present petitioners were also issued notice to join the investigation to elaborate the facts that how they changed their cast from Dheevar to Mallah.
Though they joined the investigation but could not reply satisfactorily.

Despite providing enough time, they could not produce any documents regarding how their cast changed from Dheevar (OBC) to Mallah (SC).
7.

There are clear evidences that cast of the accused persons is Dheevar cast (O.B.C.)
and still they have obtained cast certificates of Mallah cast (S.C.).

The custodial interrogation of the petitioners is required to ascertain the complete route of crime in obtaining wrong cast certificate on basis of some unknown frivolous documents."
3. It is a matter of record that the original caste certificate issued to applicant, Baburam in BAIL APPLN. 21466/2022 has not been proved to be forged.

During investigation, it has been found that the said certificate was issued by Deputy Commissioner of Delhi on 04.05.1983, vide Serial Number 1612/83, wherein the caste has been mentioned as "Mallah".
4.
It is an admitted case of the prosecution that the said document could not be verified as the record of the same was not available with the concerned authorities.

5. On the basis of the aforesaid facts, it is observed that there exists no forged document as of today,
which is alleged to have been prepared by the applicants in the present case.

sentences.text: Learned counsel submits that the present FIR has been registered on the complaint of Mr. Deepak Kumar, who is the brother-in-law of applicant/ Rashmi in BAIL APPLN. 1996/2022 and is involved in various litigations with the latter.

7. It is further submitted that two FIRs bearing FIR No. 526/2016 under Sections 498A/406 of the IPC, registered at P.S. Sangam Vihar and FIR No. 141/2018 under Sections 376/506 of the IPC registered at P.S. Sangam Vihar, registered at the instance of applicant/Rashmi are pending trial against the complainant/Mr. Deepak Kumar.
8. The applicants have joined investigation and in the totality of facts and circumstances, the present applications are allowed.

9. In the event of arrest, applicants are directed to be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond of Rs. 25,000/- each, with one surety of like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer/Investigating Officer, further subject to following conditions:
i.
The applicants shall not leave the country without prior permission of the trial Court.
ii. The applicants shall intimate the trial Court by way of an affidavit and to the Investigating Officer regarding any change in their residential address.
iii. The applicants shall appear before the Court as and when the matter is taken up for hearing.
iv. The applicants shall join investigation as and when called by the Investigating Officer concerned.
v. The applicants shall provide their mobile number to the Investigating Officer and intimate about any change.
10. The applications are allowed and disposed of accordingly.
11. Needless to state, nothing mentioned hereinabove is an opinion on the merits of the case.

12. Order to be uploaded on the website of this Court forthwith.
